title: A conversation-analytic perspective of repair initiation in ESL classroom interactions
core_idea: Using a conversation-analytic approach, the study investigates the nature and function of repair initiation as a mechanism for resolving communication breakdowns (hearing, speaking, comprehending) in Ghanaian ESL classrooms by qualitatively analysing 52 hours of classroom recordings.
tldr: A qualitative conversation-analytic study of 52 hours of Ghanaian ESL classroom recordings that examines how repair initiation functions to manage communication trouble during interaction.
